theorems.name: Submission.rsd_ae_tendsto_withDensity_div_closedBall
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (θ : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen U → Measurable θ → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K ≠ ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ.withDensity θ K ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ U → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => μ.withDensity θ (closedBall x ρ) / μ (closedBall x ρ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (θ x))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
